system_name: RA-MedFiLM-BARR (also historically designated ReMedFiLM in early development)

G.name: GlobalMedFiLM
G.input_spec: Image x in R^{1x3x512x512}, Task ID t in {0:ISIC, 1:BUSI, 2:KVASIR, 3:KUB}
G.output_spec: p_global in [0,1]^{512x512} (sigmoid foreground probability) + intermediate feature maps
G.training_objective: Combined BCE + Dice Loss on TRAIN5832 (Phase 21)

ROI_Proposal.name: Center-Preserving Connected-Component Expansion
ROI_Proposal.formula: binary = p_global >= 0.30 -> (y0, y1, x0, x1) expanded around (cy, cx) by 1.50x
ROI_Proposal.action_availability: Available iff any pixel >= 0.30; else FORCED_SKIP -> p_global

B_phi.name: BARRBenefitRouterV1
B_phi.input_dimensions: 202 numeric features (global context, shape, entropy) + 16 task embedding = 218-D
B_phi.network_structure: Linear(218->128) -> LayerNorm -> SiLU -> Dropout(0.10) -> Linear(128->64) -> LayerNorm -> SiLU -> Dropout(0.10) -> Linear(64->1)
B_phi.decision_metric: Resource-aware utility U = delta_hat_final - lambda * C, with lambda=1/4, C=1051648/10270749
B_phi.decision_branches: EXECUTE if U >= tau_C8_final; SKIP if U < tau_C8_final -> p_global
B_phi.training_objective: MSE loss against counterfactual paired Dice delta on cross-fit OOF validation (Phase 25D)

R_psi.name: BARRRegionalRefinerV1
R_psi.input_spec: B x 4 x 256 x 256 = [R, G, B, p_global_crop]
R_psi.output_spec: B x 1 x 256 x 256 raw residual logits delta_l_roi
R_psi.fusion_logic: RAMedFiLMBARR._fuse_global_with_regional (deterministic spatial insertion into global canvas, NO alpha blending)
R_psi.training_objective: Boundary-weighted BCE + Dice loss on 256x256 crops from TRAIN5832 (Phase 25A)

S_omega.name: BARRPostSafetyV1
S_omega.input_dimensions: 16 numeric comparative features (divergence, area delta, border shift) + 4 task one-hot = 20-D
S_omega.acceptance_rule: P(accept) = sigmoid(logit) >= 0.50 -> ACCEPT (output fused); else REJECT (fallback to p_global)
S_omega.training_objective: BCE loss classifying whether refinement delta > 0 on cross-fit OOF validation (Phase 25F)

runtime_paths.condition: U < tau_C8_final (Benefit router predicts low utility)
